title: Conditional 2 Writing-Satzbausteine U3/U4 ohne Travel Blog
designGoal: 100 korrekt kodierte Conditional-2-Satzbausteine fuer Klausur-Writing ohne Travel-Blog-Kontext: Internship, Museum/Rez/Education, California Opinion/Argument, Advice Email, Review, Report, Comment, Debate und Reflection.
exclusion: Travel blog was intentionally excluded because that writing format has already been tested. Travel-related review/report contexts remain only where they connect to review or argument writing, not travel-blog writing.
grammarRule: Conditional 2: if-clause in simple past; main clause with would/could/might + infinitive. Use were for If I were you. No would in the if-clause.
writingScaffoldRule: Every sentence is reusable as a sentence starter or support sentence in a later writing task. Use it with opinion, hypothetical choice, reason, example, advice, contrast, reflection, or conclusion.

sourceMaterials.use: Write about a dream internship, hypothetical choices, problems, and advice.
Write about Alia, education, the rez, community, museum work, and hypothetical alternatives.
Write an opinion paragraph about California, housing, tech, coding, climate, and social issues.
Write advice in an email about summer camp, parents, arguments, perspective, and communication.
Write a review, report, comment, reflection, or debate article with hypothetical improvements and balanced arguments.

vocabularySources: existing Unit 3/Unit 4 exam, writing, grammar and support transcripts listed in sourceMaterials
